test_dbscan_clustering: test the DBSCAN clustering algorithm with feature vector arrays using euclidean metric
test_dbscan_similarity: test the DBSCAN algorithm with a precomputed similarity or distance matrix
test_dbscan_sparse: test the DBSCAN algorithm with sparse matrix inputs like CSR and LIL containers
test_dbscan_sample_weight: test the DBSCAN algorithm with sample_weight parameter for weighted clustering
test_dbscan_core_samples: test the DBSCAN core samples detection with different algorithms like brute, kd_tree, and ball_tree
